[Discussion] What games turned out to be exactly as good as you expected them to be?

This is a great discussion question, but tricky for me because I try not to get my hopes up for a game or even evaluate it as a possible buy until after it's come out. My best answer would probably be Titanfall. I expected it to be like a slightly different Call of Duty style FPS with a good setting and balanced multiplayer, and that's more or less what it's done. Call of Duty is another one that always falls slightly higher or slightly lower than my expectations without surprising me too much.
Super Smash Brothers Melee. Back in the days, the original SSB was THE party game for me and my friends. I had high expectations for Melee and they were all fulfilled.
I still like this one more than Brawl as a followup. The current iteration is great as well, but Melee just felt right in movement and combat in a way most games don't manage to that degree.
Metal Gear Solid 2, Shadow of the Colossus and The Last of Us. Also Half-Life 2 blew my mind.

Recently, Fallout 4. I expected a game similar to FO3 and that's what I got, with quite a few surprisingly cool advancements. I love the crafting far more than 3/NV, the coding seems far more solid than the previous games with far fewer glitches and signature Bethesda weirdness, the companion AI seems better than before (at least for Dogmeat), and the new gun system is awesome.

Sure the characters are less interesting than New Vegas so far and I would love to see Obsidian can do with the new tech, but FO4 is exactly what I expected from Bethesda, nothing more, nothing less.
Borderlands 2. I absolutely loved the first one despite its obvious flaws, and the second one made all the right improvements.
